title: User friendly names should be used for HDMI/DP devices
line: HDMI and DisplayPort outputs now show the name of the connected monitor or receiver instead of the sound card's long name.
explanation: PipeWire and PulseAudio read the connected monitor's or receiver's name from its EDID and put it on the card's HDMI port as device.product.name, but Plasma only ever showed the sink description, which is the sound card plus the profile (e.g. 'HDA NVidia Digital Stereo (HDMI 2)'). On top of that, pulseaudio-qt never filled in card port properties at all: Card updated its ports with the private setInfo() instead of CardPort::update(), so the name wasn't even reachable. pulseaudio-qt now calls CardPort::update(), and plasma-pa gets a small DeviceName QML object that looks up the device's active port on its card and exposes the display name, used for the device names in the applet, the KCM and the volume OSD; a device the user renamed keeps its name.

commits.message:
card: fill in the properties of card ports

Card updated its ports through the private setInfo(), which skips the
properties, so card ports never had any, such as the name of the monitor
connected to an HDMI port. Call CardPort::update() instead, which does.

BUG: 448216

applet, kcm: name HDMI and DisplayPort outputs after the display

HDMI and DisplayPort outputs were only named after the sound card, so
several of them looked alike and the names were long. Show the name the
connected monitor or receiver reports instead, unless it was renamed.

BUG: 448216

patches.diff:
From 708246386928a409124e338a0acc07ddadc1ad88 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:30:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] card: fill in the properties of card ports

Card updated its ports through the private setInfo(), which skips the
properties, so card ports never had any, such as the name of the monitor
connected to an HDMI port. Call CardPort::update() instead, which does.

BUG: 448216
---
 src/card.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/card.cpp b/src/card.cpp
index 829eee2..60136ab 100644
--- a/src/card.cpp
+++ b/src/card.cpp
@@ -111,7 +111,7 @@ void CardPrivate::update(const pa_card_info *info)
             port = new CardPort(q);
             m_ports << port;
         }
-        port->d->setInfo(*it);
+        port->update(*it);
     }
 
     QList<CardPort *> toDiscard;
--
